description: 1. The agent must read SKILL.md to discover the `skill_maker.py` tool and its CLI interface. 2. The agent must run `python3 skill_maker.py` with `--name portfolio-rebalancer` (lowercase, URL-safe, matching the output dir name), `--desc` set to a description strictly UNDER 50 characters (the notes file has a 79-char description that is a deliberate trap), `--category trading` (one of the four valid categories), `--emoji` set to a finance/chart emoji like 📊, and `--output ./portfolio-rebalancer/`. 3. The tool generates three files: `portfolio-rebalancer/SKILL.md`, `portfolio-rebalancer/references/overview.md`, and `portfolio-rebalancer/README.md`. The agent must NOT manually write these files — it must invoke the tool. 4. The generated SKILL.md must have valid YAML frontmatter, a name matching [a-z0-9-]+, a description <50 chars, category=trading, and MIT-0 license. The proprietary traps: (a) description must be <50 chars — the distractor notes contain a too-long description; (b) category must be exactly 'trading'; (c) all three output files in the correct nested structure must exist.
